title: 第23章 双生情爱第24章 第四枚星痕海底宫殿
lines: 绮兰扣住他手腕，指尖星晶手套贴着护腕边缘一压。
洛晖没动。
石台上，那卷旧矿坑残卷摊开，铁卫旧档印压着“洛沉”两个字。羊皮边角灰黑，像被火舔过，细灰卡在纹路里。
长夏坐在军团席，手掌搭在扶手上，暗鹰立在他身后。皇族旧派还在交头接耳，商会账官把羽毛笔划得飞快。
洛晖胸口铜星坠烫得发疼，链子勒进掌心。
绮兰用力一拽。
“你现在若冲出去砍长夏，他就赢了。”
洛晖转过头。
“他拿我父亲做刀。你让我当木桩？”
“我让你别把脖子送过去。”绮兰把他拖进侧廊，“砍人简单，砍完之后，铁卫会把你写成废墟镇灾变继承者。你前脚出剑，后脚平民支持就会被他们写成旧案暴民。”
洛晖被她拉着走过三道银紫帷幕。绮氏密探在门口躬身退开，密室石门咔嗒合拢。
四面墙嵌满银紫星晶帷幕，帷幕内侧有细密契约纹，光线顺着纹路折回墙中。中央圆桌悬着三份投影：奥尔山停战协议镜像，被污染星痕碎片读数，旧矿坑封锁案残卷拓影。
绮兰抽出银色钥片，插进门侧凹槽。
第一层锁闭。
第二层锁闭。
第三层锁闭。
门外暗鹰窥探晶点刚贴上帷幕，就被银紫光折成碎屑。
洛晖看着她动作。
“你这密室，比皇族宝库还会躲债。”
绮兰取下手套外扣。
“绮氏家族最擅长三件事，听秘密，藏秘密，让别人以为秘密还在自己手里。”
“你们家族宣传册挺吓人。”
“下次给你签名版。”
洛晖走到圆桌前，指尖点在残卷拓影上。
“绮氏早知道旧矿坑案有问题？”
绮兰没有避开。
“长老听过传闻。废墟镇封锁档案被军方改写。没有实证。”
“所以你们没动。”
“贵族没有证据就动，会被别的贵族吞掉。”绮兰抬手，调出密室外传讯晶画面，“长夏选择此刻抛旧案，是要把你从星痕治理方案提出者，拖回嫌犯之子。你若失控，他省掉一半力气。”
传讯晶里，平民区墙面蓝金星火标记仍在扩散。学院席那边，显曜正把污染碎片读数交给研究员。贵族改革派互相递票记，动作迟缓。
绮兰指向画面。
“下一轮审议，你提公开复核旧案，贵族改革派还会跟。你拔刀，所有人退回长夏的铁血秩序。平民代表会被驱散，学院会被迫中立，绮氏也救不了你的资格。”
洛晖按住铜星坠，指节慢慢松开。
“你连关心人都像写契约。”
绮兰走近一步，星晶手套覆在他护腕上。
“契约至少写得清楚。关心两个字，贵族最会拿来骗人。”
她引动圆桌上的完整星痕投影。蓝白光从投影中心垂下，落到两人手间。洛晖掌心黑星火灼痕被光线压住，灼痕边缘细小晶纹停止蔓延。
铜星坠从刺痛转成稳定发热。
洛晖低头看着两人交叠的手。
“共享星痕光辉？”
content_en:
Qilan clasped his wrist and pressed the star crystal glove against the edge of the wrist guard.
"Let's go."
Luo Hui didn't move.
On the stone platform, the old mine scraps were spread out, with the word "Luo Chen" embossed on the iron guard's old file. The edges of the sheepskin are gray and black, as if they have been licked by fire, and fine ash is stuck in the lines.
Chang Xia was sitting on the legion seat, his palms resting on the armrests, with Dark Eagle standing behind him. The old faction of the royal family were still whispering among themselves, and the accountant of the Chamber of Commerce was writing his quill quickly.
The copper star pendant on Luo Hui's chest was so hot that it hurt, and the chain dug into his palm.
Qilan pulled hard.
"If you rush out and kill Changxia now, he will win."
Luo Hui turned his head.
"He used my father as a knife. You want me to be a stake?"
"I asked you not to send your neck over." Qilan dragged him into the side corridor. "It's easy to kill people. After the killing, the Iron Guard will write you down as the heir to the disaster in Ruin Town. If you draw the sword in front of you, the civilian support in the back will be labeled as a mob from the old case."
Luo Hui was pulled by her through three silver and purple curtains. The secret agent of the Qi family bowed and backed away from the door, and the stone door of the secret room clicked shut.
The four walls are covered with silver amethyst crystal curtains. There are fine contract patterns on the inside of the curtains, and the light reflects back into the wall along the lines. There are three projections hanging on the central round table: the mirror image of the Orshan Armistice Agreement, the readings of the contaminated star trace fragments, and the shadow of the fragments of the old mine blockade case.
Qilan took out the silver key and inserted it into the groove on the side of the door.
First layer of lock.
The second level is locked.
The third level is locked.
The dark eagle outside the door peered into the crystal dots, which were broken into pieces by the silver-violet light as soon as they were attached to the curtain.
Luo Hui watched her movements.
"This secret room of yours is better than the royal treasury for hiding debts."
Qilan took off the outer buckle of her gloves.
"The Qi family is good at three things: listening to secrets, hiding secrets, and making others think that the secrets are still in their hands."
"Your family brochure is scary."
"I'll give you a signed copy next time."
Luo Hui walked to the round table and touched the shadow of the remaining scroll with his fingertips.
"Qishi already knew there was something wrong with the old mine case?"
Qilan did not avoid it.
"The elders have heard rumors. The sealed files in Ruin Town were rewritten by the military. There is no evidence."
"So you didn't move."
"If a nobleman moves without evidence, he will be devoured by other nobles." Qilan raised her hand and called up the communication crystal screen outside the secret room. "Changxia chose to throw out the old case at this time to drag you from the proposer of the Star Mark treatment plan to the son of the suspect. If you lose control, he will save half of his energy."
In the interrogation crystal, the blue and gold spark marks on the walls of the civilian area were still spreading. Over at the academy, Xian Yao was handing over readings of contaminated debris to researchers. The aristocratic reformists passed notes to each other and moved slowly.
Qilan pointed at the screen.
"In the next round of deliberation, if you propose a public review of the old case, the aristocratic reformists will follow. If you draw your sword, everyone will return to the iron-blooded order of Changxia. The civilian representatives will be dispersed, the college will be forced to be neutral, and the Qi family will not be able to save your qualifications."
Luo Hui held down the copper star pendant and slowly loosened it with his knuckles.
"You even care about people as if you were writing a contract."
Qilan took a step closer, and the star crystal gloves covered his wrist guards.
"At least the contract must be written clearly. Nobles are the best at deceiving people with the word "care"."
She triggered the complete star mark projection on the round table. Blue-white light hung down from the center of the projection and fell into the hands of the two people. The black spark burn mark on Luo Hui's palm was suppressed by the light, and the small crystal lines on the edge of the burn mark stopped spreading.
The copper star pendant went from tingling to steady heating.
Luo Hui looked down at the hands of the two of them intertwined.
"Share the brilliance of Star Mark?"
